newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pinatton study wary of Moulinex - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pinatton study wary of Moulinex - paper.

text.p: French investment firm Jean-Pierre Pinatton advised investors to be wary of the stock in appliance maker Moulinex and set an objective for the stock at 128 francs, the newspaper La Tribune reported on Wednesday.

It said a Pinatton study of French companies undergoing restructurings said Moulinex "goes from restructuring plan to restructuring plan without the success expected". It said current cost cuts at the firm are insufficient and the restructuring plan proposed by the group last summer "is vital to result in a minimal improvement of the margins". Moulinex shares closed down two percent on Tuesday at 130.50 francs.
